{{External|rs}} {{Infobox Monster |name = Giant crypt rat |image = [[File:Giant crypt rat.png|250px]] |release = [[9 May]] [[2005]] |update = Barrows |members = Yes |combat = 76 |size = 2 |examine = A nasty overgrown rodent. |attributes = rat |xpbonus = 0 |max hit = 6 |aggressive = Yes |poisonous = No |attack style = [[Stab]] |attack speed = 4 |respawn = 50 |slayxp = 70 |cat = Rats |assignedby = turael,spria |hitpoints = 70 |att = 80 |str = 50 |def = 65 |mage = 1 |range = 1 |attbns = 0 |strbns = 0 |amagic = 0 |mbns = 0 |arange = 0 |rngbns = 0 |dstab = 0 |dslash = 0 |dcrush = 0 |dmagic = 0 |dlight = 0 |dstandard = 0 |dheavy = 0 |poisonresistance = 0 |venomresistance = 0 |immunecannon = No |immunethrall = No |id = 1680,1681,1682 }} '''Giant crypt rats''' are a stronger variant of [[giant rat]] that lurk in the [[Barrows]] tunnels. Giant crypt rats are one of the many obstacles between a player and the chest containing rewards where they constantly distract players from completing puzzles. As with all monsters in the crypts, they are [[aggressiveness|aggressive]] to any player regardless of their [[Combat level]].
